# SOP-P2-L4-04 Shift handover - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Preconditions
1. Incoming operator has completed pre-start checklist for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 as required in SOP-P2-L4-01.  
2. All workpieces removed from danger zones and machine guards verified locked.  
3. No active maintenance on EQ-P2-L4-RR01 or EQ-P2-L4-HP03; if maintenance present, follow ECN-2026-042 isolation steps.

PPE
1. Safety glasses.  
2. Heat-resistant gloves.  
3. Hearing protection.  
4. Protective footwear.  
(Confirm PPE compliance before entering equipment areas.)

Shift Handover Steps
1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator at the control board for P2-L4 with copy of last batch log. Confirm production status and any deviations recorded in SB-1016.  
2. Visual inspection: walk the line EQ-P2-L4-HT02 → EQ-P2-L4-RR01 → EQ-P2-L4-HP03. Note any abnormal noise, leakage, or guard issues. Tag issues in the log.  
3. Verify bolting criticals: confirm the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m and record verification in the torque log.  
4. Verify main press fasteners: confirm the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 1575 N·m and record verification in the torque log.  
5. Confirm tooling changeover status on EQ-P2-L4-RR01 and EQ-P2-L4-HP03; ensure correct coupling and guard placement before restart.  
6. Review last shift non-conformances and corrective actions from SOP-P2-L4-01 and SB-1016; ensure unresolved items are tagged for maintenance per ECN-2026-042.  
7. Run a controlled start-up of EQ-P2-L4-HT02 to verify cycle readiness; monitor for abnormalities for the first operational cycle and log results.

Sign-off
1. Outgoing operator prints name and signs the handover log.  
2. Incoming operator prints name, signs, and records time of assumption in the shift log.  
3. Supervisor verifies both signatures and initials completion of preconditions and step confirmations.

Related documents: ECN-2026-042, SB-1016, SOP-P2-L4-01
